sam_eng: quick thought — should we change reranker score semantics to a signed normalized range (-1..1) and bill/fund quotas on absolute score mass instead of candidate-count? feels like it better matches relevance drops.

maya_prod: whoa, that'll affect console dashboards and billing. any compatibility plan? :thinking_face:

leo_platform: telemetry-wise we need to record provenance per-candidate (model, version, scoring_fn) if we go signed scores. otherwise we lose ability to compare across models. also show histogram in console.

irene_sre: fallback question — if a model returns null/NaN for a candidate score, do we drop candidate or assign 0? that affects quota counting if we use abs(score).

deploy-bot: heads-up: there is an open RFC thread: https://go/internal/rfcs/rerank-score-units

sam_eng: example proto shape I had in mind:
```
request: { candidates: ["c1","c2"], context: "..." }
response: { scores: [{id: "c1", value: -0.45, confidence: 0.78, provenance: "r2-small-v3"}, {id: "c2", value: 0.12, confidence: 0.37, provenance: "r2-small-v3"}], meta: {score_unit_basis: "abs_sum"}}
```

maya_prod: breaking change risk is real. can we add `score_format: "signed_v1"` to the response and keep current `unsigned_score` for backward compat? console can pick up both.

leo_platform: routing policy thought: pick route that minimizes expected cost = sum(abs(score_i))*cost_per_score_unit + latency_penalty. we can derive cost_per_score_unit per model variant and expose in model catalog.

irene_sre: alert plan: add per-route metric `score_mass_per_minute` and trigger SLO if it shoots up 3x — indicates misrouting or a faulty model returning inflated scores.

emma_data: also need eval hooks — tag telemetry with eval_set and prompt_bucket so we can detect regressions by slice. maybe add `eval_key` in request.

sam_eng: agreed. next steps: open spec PR with compat fields + propose console patches. canary plan: route 5% traffic to signed_v1 for 48h, sample telemetry. i'll file a ticket.

maya_prod: +1, add billing estimate calc. 

leo_platform: i'll draft dashboard mocks. 

irene_sre: i'll add alerts and a playbook for NaN/drop cases. 

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-2847, branch: feature/signed-score-units

sam_eng: thanks — assigning action owners. :thumbsup:
